title: Module 18.4 — DANN Cage-Invariance: Rig Execution & Evaluation
subtitle: 2026-05-26 · executed docs/handoffs/2026-05-26_module-18.4-dann-rig.md (rsync → GPU train → 3 gates + 844 eval)

headline.lead: The DANN v2 classifier failed all three ship gates plus the real-world 844 check. The adversary never learned to discriminate cage, so cage information was fully retained while syllable accuracy collapsed — the worst-of-both-worlds outcome.
headline.summary: Cage probe 1.00 (need <0.65), syllable macro-F1 0.636 test (−0.131 vs v1, tripwire 0.05), VAE re-run FAIL on 3/4 criteria, and the held-out 844 set shows 15.8% noise recall (degenerate, near 'always-usv'). This is a STOP per ROADMAP §18.4 exit criteria, not a ship.

sections.title: Ship gates — all FAILED
sections.body: All three ROADMAP §18.4 gates must pass to ship. None did. The training script wrote its own `DO NOT SHIP` verdict to `comparison_v1_vs_v2.md`.

sections.title: Root cause — the adversary never learned
sections.body:
The failure signature is diagnostic and rules out the ROADMAP's first-suggested fix.

- **Worst-of-both-worlds:** syllable F1 dropped 0.13 **and** cage stayed perfectly decodable (probe = 1.00). A *too-aggressive* λ would push the cage probe **down** (encoder over-erasing); instead the cage was fully retained — so the adversary didn't over-work, it **didn't work at all**.
- **Smoking gun:** `domain_loss` sat flat at ~1.39 the entire run and never declined — ≈ chance for the 2-cage discriminator. The in-loop domain head never learned to separate lab from vocalmat **even though the features are perfectly separable** (the post-hoc linear probe nails them at 1.00, and the VAE re-run shows knn 0.98 / PC1 d=1.87 / per-dim d=3.31).
- **Implication:** an adversary stuck at chance sends the encoder no useful gradient, so cage info is never removed; the F1 loss is collateral perturbation from the noisy domain term at `lr=1e-3`. Therefore *slower ramp / lower γ* (ROADMAP's levers) would make an already-ineffective adversary **weaker** — wrong direction. The real lever is getting the domain head to actually train (its own optimizer / LR, domain-loss weight, per-batch domain balance).

sections.title: VAE falsifiable re-run on encoder features
sections.body: The strongest cage gate: tests invariance of the *learned* features after adversarial training. Cage structure is overwhelming.

sections.title: Held-out 844 — real-world usv/noise (bonus, new evaluator)
sections.body: Built a real patch-loading evaluator (`scripts/evaluate_held_out_844.py`, new — the `training.py` placeholder is on the do-not-touch list). The model is effectively **noise-blind**: it labels 817 of 844 patches 'usv'. Pooled accuracy (0.856) sits barely above the trivial 'always-usv' baseline (0.835) — exactly why per-class reporting was mandated.

sections.title: How we got the data onto the rig (the link saga)
sections.body:
The source domain (VocalMat, 633 MB) + manifests + `domain_unlabeled.csv` were already on the rig; only the 17 GB / 225K lab target patches were missing.

- **box→rig link is ~0.5–0.74 MB/s** (Tailscale relay; a restart didn't establish a direct path — NAT traversal failed). Full push would have been ~6.6 hr.
- **Decision (user):** subsample the DANN target to **20,000 lab patches** (seed=42, all 83 lab recordings represented) — ~1.5 GB, ~34 min. Defensible: the script supports `--max-target-samples`, and 20K richly characterizes the lab cage vs the ~12K VocalMat source. The probe=1.00 failure is not a sample-size artifact.
- **GPU contention:** the rig's 4× 3060 Ti were saturated by `docker` llama-server containers (root-owned; a bare `kill` respawned them). Freed GPUs 2 & 3 via `docker stop llama-large` (worked as `shachar`, no sudo). Left the user's contour-VAE (GPU 0, detached) and the embedding service untouched. Trained on GPU 2.
- **Warm-start verified faithful:** v1→ResNet18DANN reproduced VocalMat val F1 = 0.7693 exactly (no head-mapping bug).

deferred.title: Debug the domain-head optimization (next experiment)
deferred.body: The `domain_loss`-flat-at-chance signature points at the adversary's optimization, not the λ schedule. Inspect the adversarial loop in `train_lab_classifier_v2.py`: give the domain head its own optimizer / higher LR or a domain-loss weight; verify per-batch domain balance (source+target both present each step); confirm gradient actually flows into the domain head. See successor handoff.

deferred.title: Alternative levers if debug doesn't fix it
deferred.body: Per-recording domain granularity (richer adversarial signal than 2-cage); or pivot to CDAN/DSAN; or accept that labeled lab data is required (prior VocalMat→ours κ=0.13 is also a duration/repertoire gap DANN cannot close).

deferred.title: Full 225K target re-run (optional)
deferred.body: If a working adversary is achieved on the 20K subset, optionally re-run on the full 225K target for the canonical result — but only worth the ~6.6 hr transfer once the method is shown to work.
